name: last-words
description: Claude-managed compaction: Claude requests compaction at a prepared handoff point; the mod snapshots the transcript, compacts, and resumes Claude with its handoff files.

nudge_1_k.title: First nudge (thousands of tokens)
nudge_1_k.description: Context size at which Claude is told to take the next natural handoff point. Leave empty for the default, 400.

nudge_2_k.title: Second nudge (thousands of tokens)
nudge_2_k.description: Context size at which Claude is told to drive to a handoff point. Leave empty for the default, 700.

nudge_3_k.title: Third nudge (thousands of tokens)
nudge_3_k.description: Context size at which Claude is told to compact at the first safe point. Keep it below your auto-compaction threshold. Leave empty for the default, 850.

cooldown_k.title: Cooldown (thousands of tokens)
cooldown_k.description: Minimum context growth since the last compaction before Claude may request another, and before nudges resume. Leave empty for the default, 100.

snapshot.title: Pre-compact snapshots
snapshot.description: Before each compaction, archive the full transcript as its own session in claude --resume, with copies of the handoff files. Off unless turned on here or with LAST_WORDS_SNAPSHOT=1.
